Who we are

A DMC built on knowledge, not catalogues.

Best Holidays in Italy works with international tour operators and travel agents who need a knowledgeable, reliable partner on the ground.

We design tailor-made programmes at deluxe and first-class level — from masseria experiences in Puglia to cultural immersions in Sicily, from literary slow-travel routes through the south to private villa stays anywhere in Italy. We don't sell packages. We build journeys, one client at a time.

Based in Dublin, operating across Italy. Our team knows the producers, the families who run the properties, the roads less driven. That knowledge is what we bring to every itinerary.
